column2: System Settings home has legible cards, consistent category icons and calm high-contrast selection in dark mode.
A settings card opens its native KDE module; search and sidebar remain usable.
Appearance card opens Proper Appearance without applying settings.
Network hover shows a recognisable icon, clear title and readable status without clipping.
Audio hover uses the same hierarchy; clicking still opens native audio controls.
Notification text, actions and dismissal remain clear with the shared palette.
Light Settings home and selection are legible; tray tooltip icon and status retain contrast.
Command Centre hover has one icon/title/status popup and clicking opens its existing controls.
A disposable StatusNotifierItem retains its icon, readable tooltip and context menu.
